result.title: GeoBridge: Evolving Transferable Decoder Topologies for Geometric Vision
result.summary: Depth estimation and Gaussian reconstruction share a need for multi-scale feature processing, yet use different prediction interfaces and training objectives. Whether a decoder's internal computation can be optimized once and reused across these systems remains a structural design question. Search over primitive configurations alone leaves the organization of transformations fixed. To address this gap, we propose GeoBridge, an evolutionary framework for transferable decoder topologies. First, GeoBridge makes stage-internal topology searchable through residual, sequential, and parallel composition of configurable primitives. Shape-preserving composition retains the stage interfaces of a fixed multi-scale scaffold. Second, a functional-tree encoding supports stage-aware crossover and hierarchical mutation, while a gradient sensitivity-alignment proxy evaluates candidates without training. Multi-objective evolution balances this proxy with computation and parameter cost. Third, selected topologies are instantiated and trained in target systems with task-specific prediction interfaces. A single source search takes approximately 12 GPU hours. GeoBridgeNet-A3 achieves the best depth accuracy among four adapted decoder baselines under a common encoder and training protocol on NYU Depth V2 and KITTI. The same topology reaches 27.11 dB PSNR in Gaussian novel-view synthesis on RealEstate10K, and its refined representations support open-vocabulary segmentation on LERF. These results support decoder topology as a reusable design object across the evaluated geometric vision systems. Code and pretrained weights are available at https://github.com/EMI-Group/GeoBridge-NAS.

AI.brief_summary: GeoBridge 提出一种进化式神经架构搜索框架，把解码器中阶段内部的变换组织方式（残差、串行、并行组合）作为可搜索对象，并用功能树编码、阶段感知交叉变异及免训练的梯度敏感度对齐代理来筛选候选拓扑，最终在深度估计和高斯重建等几何视觉系统中实例化验证其可迁移性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把「变换的组合拓扑」当作可迁移设计对象、并以免训练代理快速评估候选的做法，或可迁移到 latent 推理中状态更新模块的组合结构与低成本筛选，但面向几何视觉解码器、是否适用于自回归或循环式推理状态仍需核查。
